entries.210ae355e12d02f1: This category comprises testing equipment used at medical facilities to measure specimens such as blood, convert the results into numerical values and assess patients’ injuries or illnesses. It handles blood gas analyzers, handheld blood gas analyzers, electrolyte analyzers, erythrocyte sedimentation rate measuring instruments, urinary oxidative stress marker measurement systems, and healthcare products, among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥527 million.
entries.229a33c3403b1049: Automatic blood and urine collection reception machines
entries.22b660940bac3053: This is a series of systems covering everything from reception for blood collection and urine collection testing to issuing blood collection tickets and urine cups with patient labels attached, and automating blood collection tube preparation work. By combining peripheral equipment such as automatic blood and urine collection reception machines, blood collection bed display systems, automatic specimen sorting devices, fully automatic urine analysis and aliquoting devices, general testing pretreatment devices and RFID specimen information integrated management systems, it provides a total system for each medical facility. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,892 million.
entries.3f1ba86bd0af5fbf: This category comprises consumables used in blood collection tube preparation devices and specimen testing equipment, including labels, normal calibration ion electrode standard serum, sensor cards, Gastrol, calibration packs and Harun cups, as well as equipment maintenance. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,816 million.
entries.3fc1becf22611fcd: RFID specimen information integrated management systems
entries.5a13f893a0e7c557: A company that develops, manufactures and sells medical equipment such as blood collection tube preparation systems and specimen testing equipment, and consumables.
entries.a498155bf6e6ae16: This is a single-segment business that conducts research and development, manufacturing, sales and export of clinical testing analyzers and medical equipment, as well as manufacturing, sales and maintenance services for consumables used with those devices. Research, development and design are carried out in-house, while manufacturing is outsourced to external partner companies, and products are shipped from the head office after incoming inspection and final adjustment. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥11,236 million.
